_meta.name: default
_meta.description: Current Neuraxon GoL parameter set. Copy this file to architectures/<your_name>.json and tweak. Use --architecture <path> at startup or set NEURAXON_ARCH env var.
notes: Sections are organisationally separated but loaded into one params object.
biology = game-world dynamics (food, atrophy, day/night, mate cooldown)
neural = network topology and per-neuron parameters
healthy_bands = target ranges used by the dashboard to colour-code metrics
Anything NOT in this file falls through to the code defaults in config.py.

biology._doc: Game-world / bio-inspired dynamics. Independent of neural architecture — change these to study survival pressure without touching the brain.
biology._doc_metabolic_ramp_per_sec: Multiplier added to food drain and metabolic_rate per second of idle. With 1s idle → factor (1 + 10*1) = 11×. Capped by max_atrophy.
biology._doc_max_atrophy: Hard cap on the atrophy multiplier (v151 fix). 5.0 = max 5× normal drain even after extended idle.
biology._doc_metabolic_rate_abs_cap_multiple: Absolute ceiling on the per-NxEr metabolic_rate, expressed as a multiple of the initial value (v153 F-1).
biology._doc_food: Defaults if the user doesn't change them via the menu sliders. The menu still overrides at startup.
biology._doc_idle_explore: v152 idle-exploration safety net. If an NxEr has been idle ≥ idle_explore_seconds, with explore_probability per tick, override motor output with a random direction.

neural._doc: Network architecture (topology + per-neuron parameters). Change these to test different brain configurations.
neural._doc_neuron_counts: Inputs: 10 sensory channels (movement, encounter, terrain, hunger, sight, smell, daynight, temp, proprio, song). Outputs: 7 motor (MoveX, MoveY, Social, MateIntent, GiveFood, Resting, Sing).
neural._doc_thresholds: Membrane firing thresholds (above which trinary_state = +1, below -threshold = -1). The membrane potential is a low-pass filter with intrinsic_timescale ticks. resting_potential_decay multiplies mp by (1-this) each tick before the membrane equation update.

operating_ranges._doc: Plasticity / adaptation / brake tunables. Change these to test different learning dynamics.
operating_ranges._doc_adaptation: v149: adapt builds toward 0.55 × multiplier when firing. Tau=20 ticks. Excitatory uses 1.5× to bias the brake against +1 dominance.
operating_ranges._doc_autoreceptor: Per-neuron autoreceptor that subtracts from theta1_eff (v154 sign back to v152 form — see CHANGELOG_v154 for context).
operating_ranges._doc_sensory_boost: v152 saturating cap: boosted_external = scale * tanh(scale * external_input). Asymptote = scale. 1.0 keeps strong inputs near threshold; lowering compresses further.
operating_ranges._doc_plasticity_brake: v152: when input_saturation_fraction > brake_threshold, learning_rate_mod is multiplied by max(floor, 1 - slope*(sat-threshold)).

healthy_bands._doc: Target ranges shown on the dashboard. NxErs operating in these bands are coloured green.
